sets.relationshipLabel: worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A mariner relies on a compass to find direction just as a navigator relies on a chart to find a route.

sets.relationshipLabel: structure and the part it cannot be without
sets.explanation: A lighthouse is not a lighthouse without its lantern room, just as a ship is not a ship without its hull.

sets.relationshipLabel: two counterparts of the same kind, side by side
sets.explanation: A principal keeper and assistant keeper share one post just as a beacon and foghorn share one duty, warning ships by sight and by sound.

sets.relationshipLabel: start and end of one span
sets.explanation: Dusk gives way to dawn across one night just as ebb gives way to flood across one tide, each pair marking the two ends of its own cycle.
